title: Ukrainian Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful Ukrainian-inspired casserole made with garlicky kissed cheese.
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent.
In a separate saucepan, melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk together to make a roux.
Slowly add the milk, whisking constantly.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Stir in the shredded cheese until melted and smooth.
In a separate dish, combine the crushed casserole and grated cheese.
Pour the cheese sauce over the casserole mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
